court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Mumbai (case number not mentioned)
case_name: Mrs. Arti Jayprakash Yadav vs Mr. Jayprakash Yadav
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2004. The respondent-husband filed a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, which was allowed by the trial court. The trial court also ordered custody of minor sons to be handed over to the respondent-husband. The petitioner-wife appealed against this order.

legal_principles.principle: A party's refusal to reconcile despite efforts by the other party can be considered desertion.
legal_principles.held: It is alleged that even thereafter repeated efforts were made by the Respondent-husband and his father but the Appellant-wife continued to be adamant and non co-operative.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to perform their duties as a spouse can be considered desertion.
legal_principles.held: It is alleged that since the beginning, the Appellant-wife has not performed her duty as a faithful wife.

outcome.final_order: The impugned judgment and decree were upheld, and the marriage was dissolved by a decree of divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
